specs.description: The 540-ds MCP server gives an AI agent a registry of read-only tools (mcp/tools/index.ts) to query the design system while it assembles a piece: get-design-guide, list-templates, get-rules, get-template, get-patterns, get-template-stops, list-components, search-components, get-component, get-component-docs, get-component-stories, get-tokens and search-images. Every listed tool is annotated read-only. get-design-guide returns src/docs/diseno.md without the note for editors. list-templates lists every piece type in PIECE_TYPES with what it is, its triggers and the tools that have data for it, and the pieceType enum of the template tools is taken from the same source (PIECE_TYPE_IDS). Only talks are served: any other piece type is refused. get-rules returns the talk rules, also when no pieceType is given. list-components filters by level. get-component returns props with their types, defaults and descriptions, finds parts and tag names, and, when it finds none, suggests up to five component or part names only where the normalized name contains the normalized query, or the normalized query, longer than 2 characters, contains the name; a typo such as "Buton" gets no suggestion. get-component-docs returns the component's sheet in Markdown. get-component-stories includes story code only when asked. search-components is a literal text match, not a match by meaning: it folds the query (accents removed, lowercase), splits it into terms longer than one character, and scores each term found as literal text in the component and part names (10), their descriptions (4), the prop names and descriptions (2) and the docs (1 per occurrence, at most 5), returning the 8 highest-scoring components; a Spanish word such as "cita" finds a component only because its docs are in Spanish and contain that word. get-tokens filters by category and text. get-template gives the shell and the index of stops without their code. get-template-stops returns each stop's code with its helpers and sample assets, and reports ids it does not know. search-images finds photos by theme, applies filters and skips photos already used. get-patterns filters by need and points to stops.
specs.name: MCP tools

specs.description: The 540-ds MCP server is reached over Streamable HTTP through a stateless, Web-standard handler (mcp/http.ts), and the local server and the Firebase function bridge Node's HTTP objects to it (mcp/node-adapter.ts). createServer(metadata) builds an MCP server named 540-ds whose instructions are metadata.instructions.content, and registers every tool of the registry annotated read-only. handleMcpRequest(request, metadata) answers OPTIONS with 204 and open CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin *); answers any method other than POST, such as GET or DELETE, with 405, a JSON-RPC error and the header Allow: POST, OPTIONS; and gives each POST its own server and transport with no session: the answer is plain JSON with no Mcp-Session-Id header, initialize returns the server info and instructions, and tools can be listed and called without a session. Every answer carries the open CORS headers. toWebRequest(req, origin, rawBody) turns a Node request into a Web Request with the same method, the URL resolved against origin and every header, a repeated header keeping all its values; a GET or HEAD request carries no body; otherwise the body is rawBody when it is given, else it is streamed from the Node request. sendWebResponse(res, response) writes the response's status, headers and whole body to the Node response.
specs.name: MCP transports

specs.description: The server side of the island runtime (src/runtime/server.ts and src/runtime/islands.ts) turns design-system components into static HTML that the client runtime later hydrates. registryOf collects, from the modules it is given, every export whose name starts with a capital letter and whose value is a component (a function, or an object with $$typeof), keyed by its export name; other exports are left out. ISLAND_TAG is 'ds-island' and SLOT_TAG is 'ds-slot'. renderIsland(registry, {name, props, id, slots}) throws '540-ds: component "<name>" is not registered' when the registry has no component of that name; otherwise it renders the component with its revived props to HTML, with id as the prefix of every id the component generates with useId, and wraps that HTML as <ds-island data-c="<name>" data-id="<id>" data-p="<props as JSON>">, escaping &, " and < in those attributes. revive turns encoded props back into props: an object with a string $slot becomes a Slot rendered as <ds-slot data-s="<slot id>"> holding that slot's HTML, and renderIsland throws '540-ds: slot "<slot id>" has no HTML' when its slots have no entry for it; an object with a string $el becomes an element of that HTML tag when the name starts with a lowercase letter, otherwise of the registered component of that name, with its revived p as props, and revive throws '540-ds: component "<name>" is not registered; include its island' when no such component is registered; any other array, object or plain value is revived member by member and keeps its shape. renderStatic(element, id) renders an element the same way, with id as the prefix of its generated ids, without the island wrapper. renderToString(element, {identifierPrefix}) renders it with identifierPrefix as that prefix, or none when it is absent, and renderToStaticMarkup is the same function.
specs.name: Island server rendering
